hypothesis: Full-resolution local intensity centroids can correct sub-voxel detector localization without changing node count, improving official pooled edge matching after registered linking.
parent: EXP190 exact fixed complete-graph policy: registered translation linker plus minimum component length 8 forward and 3 reverse.
data_and_protocol: Existing reciprocal embryo-disjoint 24-movie OOF detector-coordinate caches and corresponding raw image volumes. Both directions complete before comparison; no neural inference and no GPU.
fixed_candidate: For every cached node, round to its raw-image voxel, crop radius z=2/y=5/x=5, subtract the crop minimum, and replace the coordinate with the positive-intensity weighted centroid. Preserve time and node count; recompute the exact registered translation linker and fixed direction-specific short-track pruning.
selection: None. One source-attributed fixed candidate is compared with the exact parent across all 24 movies.
evidence_rule: Exact parent reproduction within 1e-12 is mandatory. A positive pooled delta is a useful exploratory result; robust promotion additionally requires nonnegative directional deltas and a positive lower 95 percent bound from 20,000 direction-stratified paired movie bootstrap draws.
interpretation_guard: This already-open development cohort cannot modify the frozen EXP192/201/202 policies. A positive result may define a separately preregistered future confirmation only before its target metrics are opened.

implementation.local_bash_check: NOT_AVAILABLE: local WSL service returned E_ACCESSDENIED; remote bash -n is mandatory before execution.

resource: CPU-only on nsu-quadro: 8 threads, <=16 GiB RAM, <0.1 GiB output, no GPU lease. Input readiness is already established by prior 24-movie runs.
